parameter: EIA 3.1 Noise, operation: night and day limits at the nearest residential receptor
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-HS-STU-0001 (noise study); ALP-EPC-00000-HS-DBR-0001; noise survey ALP-EPC-00000-CM-TRP-0006. Status preliminary until the noise study is issued.
value_text: Plant noise is designed to the near-field limit DP-CASE-0044 and to the night limit at the nearest receptor DP-CASE-0045 (ER-14.03, ER-14.04); the noise study predicts the levels at the receptor with the equipment noise data and defines the attenuation (silencers, enclosures, cladding). The day limit of the EIA is DP-EPCE-0010.
